title: BAGMAN MailboxSweepRun
description: One durable sweep-attempt ledger row for a single `MailboxSource` (CD-6 Slice 4). Mirrors `services.xero.sync.XeroSyncRun`'s own role for the Xero domain: a terminal record of exactly what one sweep attempt did, never SUCCEEDED if a message that should have ingested failed irrecoverably.

sweep_run_id.description: Canonical BAGMAN identifier for this sweep attempt.

trigger.description: `MANUAL` — an operator clicked 'Sweep now'. `SCHEDULED` — the optional dedicated worker (see `services/mailbox/sweep.py`'s module docstring for whether this slice built one).

status.description: `SUCCEEDED` — every folder's delta round completed and every discovered message reached a durably-handled terminal record (ingested, quarantined, or a governed vanished/oversize outcome). `PARTIAL` — at least one folder/message hit a transient failure but at least one other folder/message succeeded; the affected folder's cursor is NOT advanced. `FAILED` — nothing durable was accomplished this run (e.g. token refresh failed before any folder could even be attempted).

folder_id.description: The provider's own real, immutable folder identifier — the canonical value; never a display name.

display_name.description: Human-readable label for GUI/operator rendering only.

folders_attempted.description: CD-6 architect amendment (recursive folder discovery). Which folders this run actually attempted — now the REAL, per-mailbox discovered/monitored folder set (Inbox, Junk Email, Deleted Items, every custom/nested/hidden folder discovered; never Sent Items/Drafts/Outbox), not a hardcoded two-value list. Each entry carries both the canonical folder id and a human-readable display name so a GUI never has to render a raw opaque Graph folder id as if it were a friendly name.

messages_seen.description: Total messages observed across every attempted folder's delta pages this run (including ones already known from a prior sweep).

messages_new.description: Messages discovered for the FIRST time this run (new `MailboxMessage` rows created).

evidence_created.description: New `EvidenceItem` rows successfully registered this run.

duplicates.description: Messages seen this run whose (mailbox_id, immutable_provider_message_id) already had a `MailboxMessage`/`EvidenceItem` — an idempotent re-observation (e.g. a re-seen page, or a message that moved folders), never double-ingested.

quarantined.description: Messages whose content-safety scan was not CLEAN — governed-quarantined, never parsed/classified.

failures.description: Messages that hit a transient, non-durably-handled failure this run (their folder's cursor is not advanced past them).

error_code.description: Closed-vocabulary failure reason when `status` is `PARTIAL`/`FAILED` (see `services/mailbox/sweep.py::SweepFailureReason`). `null` for `RUNNING`/`SUCCEEDED`.

error_detail.description: Short, non-secret detail. NEVER a raw token/deltaLink/authorization code/OAuth state.
